Per-tier row counts printed and reconciled against the 27+7+6 roster shape: M+ S 4 / A 13 / B 19 / C 4 = 40 and raid S 6 / A 11 / B 17 / C 6 = 40, 0 duplicate (spec, bracket) pairs. The M+ page's four extra tier blocks are the dungeon-difficulty list and were rejected by ROSTER MATCH rather than by position — the 8 unmatched entries are exactly the eight dungeon names. 12 of the 40 M+ letters moved (Arms A→S, Elemental A→S, Beast Mastery B→A, Unholy B→A, Assassination B→A, Subtlety B→A, Retribution B→A, Prot Paladin A→B, Holy Priest C→B, Balance A→B, Destruction A→B, Devastation B→C) and 0 of the 40 raid letters; every move is adjacent on Method's S/A/B/C scale, so 0 two-band moves against anomaly.maxTwoBandMoves 6 and 12 total against maxTotalMoves 25. Consensus effect: 4 letters, all M+, all one band.

All six registered pages fetched fresh in THIS session by direct browser-header GET, HTTP 200, 76,499–346,694 B of real decompressed body (not a compressed size_download reading). Parsed the current working way: unescape \/ → / across the whole document FIRST, then locate [tier-list=rows] … [/tier-list] and match each [tier-label] with tolerant whitespace — never anchored on WH.markup.printHtml(, whose raid-healer decoy produced the 2026-08-01 zero-row incident. Exactly one tier-list block per page; per-page row counts printed: raid 27/7/6 and M+ 27/7/6 = 80 rows, 0 unmatched [spec-badge=…] slugs, 0 duplicates. Each page's own dateModified read and byte-identical to the pre-agent published-evidence receipt: raid DPS/Healer/Tank 2026-08-31, M+ DPS 2026-08-28, M+ Healer 2026-09-10, M+ Tank 2026-09-01 — so the published dates are carried forward because the pages say so, not because they were assumed. All six titles self-identify as "Midnight Season 2" → seasonVerified "s2"; the 12.1.5 tokens on the pages are sidebar news links, and a patch inside the season does not move the season. 0 of 80 letters moved.

Fetched and parsed COMPLETE through the JSON API (never the HTML prerender, never a proxy): two plain curl calls, no headers, no auth. manifest.json HTTP 200 with snapshotDate 2026-09-15 (completedAt 2026-09-15T14:25:48.118Z) — pinned for 21 days — while rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json returned HTTP 200, 161,794 B, Last-Modified "Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:16:55 GMT", and ALL 40 lowerBound values and all 40 numberOfCharacters had changed against stored. That is the documented 2026-08-04 shape: the manifest step and the rankings step run independently, so a pinned snapshotDate is NOT evidence the data is frozen, and the payload is diffed every run rather than trusted to the manifest. Selected by WHITELIST — categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} AND sortField === "lowerBound" AND keyRange === undefined — giving 27+7+6 = 40 rows out of 44 blocks with 0 unknown roster keys, so the melee/ranged subsets could not double-count. Merged at the stored 1-decimal precision with n = numberOfCharacters and asOf = the SOURCE's own lagging 2026-09-15, never today, which is why the coverage date correctly does not move and this row cannot be success. Every move is small — all 40 inside about ±1.5%, the largest absolute being Guardian Druid 368 → 373 on n 88,773 → 96,577 — far inside maxValueMovePct 0.6, so nothing was held back and no value_move_ack is needed. The raid endpoint was deliberately not ingested: its lowerBound is DPS throughput, a different quantity on a different scale. Note for the standing owner red: the "nothing to merge" clause no longer describes this source — there WAS something to merge, under an unchanged upstream date.

Verified this run by the trusted pre-agent fetch-stable-metrics.mjs step and merged ONLY through node src/apply-metrics.mjs metrics-fetch/updates.json; no second parser was written agent-side. metrics-fetch/evidence.json (checkedAt 2026-10-06T16:57:02.341Z) reports murlok status "success": all three pages HTTP 200 on the first attempt (71,309 / 42,298 / 40,902 B), roleCounts 27 DPS / 7 Healer / 6 Tank = 40 contiguous rows, omittedSpecs empty. The source's own date is unchanged at 2026-10-03, taken from its <time datetime> (dateBasis "source-time-datetime", sourceTimestamps 2026-10-03T10:10:23Z / 10:13:12Z / 10:11:13Z) rather than from the rendered "Updated N hours ago" string or from today. That makes the stored coverage date 3 days old, outside checkManifest's one-day success bound, so this is partial even though the fetch and parse were complete — the real staleness signal is murlok's maxAgeDays 5 in the contract, which it is still inside. node src/check-stable-metrics.mjs passes against the trusted receipts and Git HEAD.

Fetched fresh and complete: all 27 DPS specs requested at talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with snake_case class names. 23 charts returned data and 4 returned the 76-byte {"status": "error", "message": "No standard chart with these values found."} body — Balance Druid, Augmentation Evoker, Devastation Evoker and Subtlety Rogue, which has been erroring since 2026-10-03 and is not new tonight. Each of the four was retried 3x at 2s spacing and failed on 12 of 12 attempts while the other 23 succeeded interleaved in the same minutes, so the endpoint was demonstrably healthy and this is upstream absence, not transport. simc_settings.ptr was compared explicitly against the string "0" (it is truthy in JS); the tier was read off every chart rather than asserted, and all 23 read MID2, matching the stored pool, so the uniformity gate sees no mix; targets were taken from data[MID2][count], which is already best-build. ALL 23 charts are byte-identical to stored — same per-chart timestamp date 2026-09-30 and a maximum relative target move of 0.00% — so the merge was a no-op and the coverage date correctly does not advance (6 days, inside maxAgeDays 8; upstream re-sims about weekly). asOf is each chart's OWN timestamp, never the run date, which is exactly why this row is partial. Subtlety's stored profile (2026-09-23, MID2) is simply retained, which is what upstream absence means; the pool stays 24 rows and tier-uniform. The 12.1.5 partial-re-sim hold was checked and does NOT apply: PHASES.livePatch is null, LABEL_FLIP_DUE is null, and nothing in this run's evidence says 12.1.5 is live (Blizzard's own announcement dates it October 13), so the ordinary merge branch is correct.
